description: Explain the Guard product using CurrencyGuard's approved product and FAQ content. Covers: what the Guard is, how it works, who it is for, how it compares to a forward or to doing nothing, and legal, regulatory, accounting, or eligibility questions. Compare the Guard only with a forward and with doing nothing, as the product text does. If asked to compare it with any other FX product, give the FAQ's definition of what the Guard is and is not, and do not build the comparison: no table, no matching of the Guard fee or the Guard rate to that product's terms.
name: explain_guard_product
